title: Auth endpoints
description: Reference for /api/auth — registration, login, OTP, password reset and profile.
text: All auth endpoints live under /api/auth. POST /auth/signup Register a new user. Sends an OTP to the given email/phone. json { "email": "you@example.com", "password": "secret", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000", "role": "client" } Field Required Notes ------- ---------- ------- email yes Valid email password yes Min 6 chars fullName yes Full name phoneNumber yes For OTP role no client default; vendor/service provider start pending POST /auth/login Email + password login. Returns data.token. POST /auth/otp/verify json { "code": "123456", "email": "you@example.com", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000" } Returns a JWT when the code is verified. POST /auth/me GET current user profile including businessProfile and default address. Auth required. Password recovery Endpoint Body Purpose ---------- ------ --------- POST /auth/forgot-password/send { "email" } Send reset OTP POST /auth/forgot-password/verify { "code", "email" } Verify reset code POST /auth/forgot-password/reset { "email", "code", "password" } Set new password Google sign-in POST /auth/google with { "idToken" } from the Google OAuth client. Returns a JWT. Other endpoints Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /auth/otp/send — Send a verification OTP POST /auth/otp/link JWT Link a phone to the account POST /auth/logout JWT Invalidate session POST /auth/refresh — Refresh token POST /auth/check-exists — Check user existence POST /auth/change-password JWT Change password <Callout type="note" Certain privileged endpoints (such as account impersonation) are reserved for platform administrators and are not documented publicly. </Callout

title: API conventions
description: Base URL, response envelopes, error format, pagination and common patterns.
text: Every endpoint in this reference follows the same conventions. Base URL text https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api Response envelope Successful responses use a consistent envelope: <CodeBlock title="Success shape" json { "status": "success", "data": { ... } } </CodeBlock Some endpoints return a top-level array or a flat object; check each endpoint's example. Error format Errors always return a 4xx/5xx status with: <CodeBlock title="Error shape" json { "status": "error", "message": "Human-readable explanation", "code": "OPTIONAL MACHINE CODE" } </CodeBlock Status Meaning -------- --------- 400 Bad request / validation failed 401 Missing or invalid token 403 Role not permitted 404 Resource not found 429 Rate limited 503 Feature disabled (feature guard) Pagination List endpoints accept page and limit query params and return paginated data, e.g.: <CodeBlock title="Paginated shape" json { "status": "success", "data": { "items": [], "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 143, "totalPages": 8 } } </CodeBlock Filtering & search Most list endpoints support search, category, sort and other filters via query params. The global search endpoint exposes cross-entity search. Soft deletes Resources marked with deletedAt are soft-deleted: they disappear from normal queries but remain in the database until permanently removed by an admin. Date & time All timestamps are returned in ISO 8601 UTC strings.

title: Flash sales
description: Reference for /api/flash-sales — active sales, vendor participation and superAdmin management.
text: Flash sales give products discounted prices for a limited window. Vendors submit products for participation, which a superAdmin must approve before the product is discounted. Flash sale shape Field Type Notes ------- ------ ------- id string UUID name string Sale name description string? Optional description discountPercent int Must be between 1 and 90 startsAt string ISO 8601, when the window opens expiresAt string ISO 8601, when the window closes isActive bool Default true products json? Optional product payload deletedAt string? Set on soft delete Participant status workflow Each participation has a status: pending → approved rejected A vendor's join creates a pending participant. A superAdmin then approves or rejects it; only approved participants see the discounted price. Endpoints Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /flash-sales/active Public Currently active flash sales POST /flash-sales/join/:flashSaleId vendor Submit a product for a flash sale GET /flash-sales/admin/list superAdmin List flash sales POST /flash-sales/admin/create superAdmin Create a flash sale PATCH /flash-sales/admin/:id superAdmin Update a flash sale DELETE /flash-sales/admin/:id superAdmin Soft-delete a flash sale PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/approve superAdmin Approve a participant PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/reject superAdmin Reject a participant GET /flash-sales/active Public. Returns the sales that are active, not deleted and currently within their window (startsAt ≤ now ≤ expiresAt), ordered by soonest expiry. Each sale includes a participantsCount. <CodeBlock title="Response" json [ { "id": "...", "name": "Back to School", "description": "School supplies at a discount", "discountPercent": 25, "startsAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z", "expiresAt": "2026-08-09T23:59:59.000Z", "isActive": true, "products": null, "participantsCount": 4 } ] </CodeBlock POST /flash-sales/join/:flashSaleId Vendor submits one of their own products. Body: json { "productId": "..." } productId is required. Returns 201 with the new participant in pending status. Status Condition -------- ----------- 400 No productId, sale not currently active, product already submitted, or tier participation cap reached 403 Product does not belong to the vendor's business 404 Flash sale or product not found 503 flash sales feature flag disabled Participation is capped by the vendor's subscription tier, counting pending + approved participants: Tier Max active participations ------ --------------------------- free 1 pro 3 business 5 enterprise 10 <Callout type="note" Joining a flash sale only creates a pending participation — a superAdmin must approve it before the product is included in the sale. </Callout Admin endpoints POST /flash-sales/admin/create Body: json { "name": "Back to School", "description": "School supplies at a discount", "discountPercent": 25, "startsAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z", "expiresAt": "2026-08-09T23:59:59.000Z" } name, discountPercent, startsAt and expiresAt are required. discountPercent must be between 1 and 90 and expiresAt must be after startsAt. Returns 201 with the created sale. GET /flash-sales/admin/list List sales with page/limit pagination. Filter with status: status Returns ---------- --------- active Currently running sales upcoming Sales that have not started expired Sales past their expiresAt inactive Sales with isActive: false (omitted) All non-deleted sales <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "flashSales": [ { "id": "...", "name": "Back to School", " count": { "participants": 4 } } ], "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 1, "totalPages": 1 } } </CodeBlock PATCH /flash-sales/admin/:id Partially updates a sale. Any of name, description, discountPercent, startsAt, expiresAt, isActive (accepts boolean or "true"/"false" string). Returns 404 if the sale does not exist or is deleted. DELETE /flash-sales/admin/:id Soft-deletes the sale (sets deletedAt/deletedBy; data is preserved). Returns 404 if not found or already deleted. PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/approve Approves a pending participant. Returns 400 if the participant is not pending, 404 if not found. PATCH /flash-sales/admin/participant/:id/reject Rejects a pending participant. Same error behaviour as approve.

title: Orders, cart & bookings
description: Reference for /api/orders, /api/cart and /api/bookings — checkout, fulfilment and delivery.
text: Orders, cart and bookings cover the purchasing flow. Cart (/api/cart) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /cart/add JWT Add/increment item GET /cart JWT Get cart with product details PATCH /cart/:id JWT Update quantity DELETE /cart/:id JWT Remove item POST /cart/clear JWT Clear cart <Callout type="note" The /api/cart HTTP endpoints are currently frozen — the router is not mounted in app.js (cart is frontend-held). Authenticated checkout still reads items from the CartItem table. See the data model. </Callout Orders (/api/orders) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /orders/checkout JWT Create order from cart (COD when payment service is off) POST /orders/express-checkout Optional Guest purchase without an account, tracked by order code GET /orders JWT Your orders GET /orders/vendor vendor+ Orders with your products GET /orders/:id JWT Single order (owner, delivery person or vendor) GET /orders/track/:orderCode Public Track a guest/express order by reference code POST /orders/:orderCode/pay Public Initiate payment for a guest order by reference code POST /orders/:orderCode/cancel Public Cancel a guest order by reference code (optional phone guard) PUT /orders/:id/status vendor+ Update status (optional suborderId) PUT /orders/:id/verify-recipient JWT Client confirms receipt (optional suborderId) POST /orders/verify-qr delivery/vendor/admin Verify a suborder via its QR payload PUT /orders/:id/deliver delivery/vendor+ Mark delivered, record collectedAmount (optional suborderId) PUT /orders/:id/negotiate vendor+ Set negotiatedAmount for a suborder PUT /orders/:id/cancel JWT Cancel (pending/confirmed only, records cancelReason) GET /orders/sales-report vendor Period sales report Suborders Checkout splits the order into one suborder per vendor business (see data model). Each suborder has its own status and recipientCode. Mutations that act on one vendor's share accept an optional suborderId so the backend targets the correct suborder instead of the whole order: - PUT /orders/:id/status → body { "status": "confirmed", "suborderId": "..." } - PUT /orders/:id/verify-recipient → body { "recipientId": "<recipientCode ", "suborderId": "..." } - POST /orders/verify-qr → body { "orderId": "...", "suborderId": "...", "recipientId": "<recipientCode " } - PUT /orders/:id/deliver → body { "recipientId": "<recipientCode ", "suborderId": "...", "collectedAmount": 15000 } - PUT /orders/:id/negotiate → body { "negotiatedAmount": 14000, "suborderId": "..." } - POST /delivery/assign → body { "orderId": "...", "deliveryPersonId": "...", "suborderId": "..." } - PUT /delivery/:id/verify → body { "recipientId": "<recipientCode ", "suborderId": "..." } The delivery QR payload encodes the suborder as { v:1, o:<suborderId , r:<recipientCode , s:1 } — clients render it as a QR code and verification endpoints resolve o/r back to suborderId + recipientId. Checkout body json { "hasDelivery": true, "deliveryAddress": "Kijitonyama, Dar es Salaam", "deliveryLat": -6.79, "deliveryLng": 39.22, "deliveries": [ { "businessId": "...", "hasDelivery": true, "deliveryLocation": "Mikocheni" } ] } deliveries is an optional per-business array that overrides delivery per suborder. A deliveryLocation must be served by the business's delivery zones; otherwise the business's flat deliveryFee applies. Cash on Delivery When the payment service feature is off , online payments are disabled but ordering and checkout keep working. Checkout responds with: json { "message": "Order placed successfully", "order": { ... }, "requiresPayment": false, "escrowCreated": true } - requiresPayment: false → no gateway payment is expected; the order is placed as Cash on Delivery and the delivery agent collects on handover. - escrowCreated → the escrow record is still created (default), so funds collected at delivery are held and released per suborder when verified. - When payment service is on , requiresPayment: true and the gateway payment (ClickPesa) is initiated instead. - POST /orders/:orderCode/pay returns { "requiresPayment": false } with a COD notice when payment service is off. Order statuses pending → confirmed → shipped → delivered cancelled - Confirming a suborder generates its recipientCode (used for the 3-way delivery verification and the QR payload). - Delivering a suborder records collectedAmount (defaults to negotiatedAmount ?? subtotal), releases that suborder's escrow share and credits the business. - Cancelling (customer or guest) is only allowed while pending/confirmed; it sets cancelReason on the order and suborders and refunds escrow. - returned is accepted only via the admin route (PUT /admin/orders/:orderId/status). <Callout type="note" Multi-vendor orders generate one recipient code per suborder , verified against the matching business's share. OrderItem rows carry variant snapshots (variantId, variantName, variantType) plus selectedSpecs/notes. </Callout Bookings (/api/bookings) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /bookings client Book a service GET /bookings/my client Your bookings GET /bookings/vendor service provider Provider's bookings PUT /bookings/:id/accept service provider Accept + generate booking code PUT /bookings/:id/reject service provider Reject POST /bookings/verify-qr service provider/admin Verify a booking QR Delivery (/api/delivery) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /delivery/create vendor+ Create delivery person GET /delivery/my-team vendor+ List team POST /delivery/assign vendor+ Assign a suborder (→ shipped) GET /delivery/my-deliveries delivery Assigned deliveries GET /delivery/my-stats delivery Delivery stats PUT /delivery/:id/verify delivery Verify handover (optional suborderId) PUT /delivery/my-status delivery Active/offline toggle GET /delivery/calculate Public Delivery fee for location GET /delivery/zones/public Public Business delivery zones

title: Referrals & credits
description: Reference for /api/referrals and /api/credits — the referral program and the credits reward system.
text: The referral program and the credits system are one feature, controlled by a single flag ecommerce:referral credits. When the flag is disabled, the user-facing endpoints below return 503 with the configured message; the admin endpoints are unaffected. <CodeBlock title="Feature disabled (503)" json { "message": "Referral system is currently unavailable", "feature": "referral credits", "enabled": false } </CodeBlock All endpoints require a JWT. Admin endpoints additionally require the superAdmin role. Referral rewards Credits are awarded when a referral is marked completed: Who Credits Description ----- --------- ------------- Referrer 5,000 Referral reward for referring a user Referred user 2,000 Welcome bonus for being referred A completed referral records rewardAmount: 7000 (5,000 + 2,000). Earned credits expire after 6 months . Referrals (/api/referrals) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /referrals/my JWT The current user's referred users GET /referrals/stats JWT Referral statistics GET /referrals/code JWT Your referral code (generates and persists one if missing) POST /referrals/apply JWT Apply someone's referral code GET /referrals/admin/all superAdmin All referrals (paginated) GET /referrals/my <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "referrals": [ { "id": "...", "status": "pending", "expiresAt": "2026-11-07T00:00:00.000Z", "rewardAmount": null, "createdAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z", "referred": { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@example.com", "createdAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z" } } ] } </CodeBlock GET /referrals/stats <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "stats": { "totalReferrals": 3, "completedReferrals": 1, "pendingReferrals": 2, "totalCreditsEarned": 7000 } } </CodeBlock GET /referrals/code Returns the current user's referral code, generating and persisting one when it is missing. Codes follow the SP- prefix followed by 8 characters (A–Z, 0–9). <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "referralCode": "SP-AB12CD34" } </CodeBlock POST /referrals/apply <CodeBlock title="Request" json { "referralCode": "SP-AB12CD34" } </CodeBlock Status Case -------- ------ 200 Code applied — { "message": "Referral code applied successfully" } 400 Missing code, code already applied, or using your own code 404 Invalid / unrecognised code A referral code can only be applied once, and never to your own code. The referral record starts as pending. GET /referrals/admin/all Query params page, limit (default 1, 20) and an optional status filter. <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "referrals": [ ... ], "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 42, "pages": 3 } } </CodeBlock Credits (/api/credits) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /credits/my JWT Current credit balance GET /credits/history JWT Credit transaction history POST /credits/redeem JWT Redeem credits for a feature GET /credits/admin/user/:userId superAdmin A user's credits + transactions POST /credits/admin/adjust superAdmin Manually adjust a user's credits GET /credits/my <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "credits": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "balance": 5000, "totalEarned": 5000, "totalRedeemed": 0, "totalExpired": 0 } } </CodeBlock GET /credits/history <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "history": [ { "id": "...", "type": "earned", "amount": 5000, "description": "Referral reward for referring user", "referenceType": "referral", "referenceId": "...", "expiresAt": "2027-02-07T00:00:00.000Z", "createdAt": "2026-08-07T00:00:00.000Z" } ] } </CodeBlock Transaction type values: earned, redeemed, adjusted (admin), expired. POST /credits/redeem Body { "feature": "...", "amount": ... } — amount is optional and defaults to the feature's cost. Feature Cost (credits) --------- ---------------- product boost 500 service pin 500 featured listing 1,500 pro trial 2,000 pro month 5,000 business month 10,000 <CodeBlock title="Request" json { "feature": "product boost" } </CodeBlock <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "message": "Credits redeemed successfully", "credit": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "balance": 4500, "totalEarned": 5000, "totalRedeemed": 500, "totalExpired": 0 } } </CodeBlock An invalid feature returns 400 with a validFeatures list; an insufficient balance returns 400 with Insufficient credits. <Callout type="note" Credits are spent by redeeming them for a platform feature via POST /credits/redeem — they are not deducted automatically at order checkout. </Callout GET /credits/admin/user/:userId <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "user": { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@example.com" }, "credits": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "balance": 5000, "totalEarned": 5000, "totalRedeemed": 0, "totalExpired": 0 }, "transactions": [ ... ] } </CodeBlock POST /credits/admin/adjust <CodeBlock title="Request" json { "userId": "...", "amount": 1000, "description": "Promotional bonus" } </CodeBlock amount must be a non-zero number. Positive values increment totalEarned; negative values increment totalRedeemed and are rejected with 400 when they exceed the current balance. <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "message": "Credits adjusted successfully", "credit": { ... } } </CodeBlock
