title: Subscriptions
description: Reference for /api/subscriptions — plan tiers, pricing, upgrades, downgrades and vendor listing limits.
text: Vendor and service-provider accounts hold a subscription with a plan tier that sets listing limits and feature entitlements. Plan tiers & pricing Tiers are free, pro, business and enterprise. Prices are in TZS per month and differ by account type. Tier Vendor / month Service provider / month Max products Max services ------ ---------------- -------------------------- -------------- -------------- free 0 0 10 3 pro 25,000 20,000 50 15 business 75,000 60,000 200 50 enterprise 150,000 120,000 Unlimited Unlimited A subscription stores tier, price, startDate, endDate, isActive, isTrial, paymentMethod, autoRenew and autoDowngrade. When no active subscription exists the account effectively runs on free. Endpoints Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /subscriptions/my JWT Current subscription, limits and prices POST /subscriptions/subscribe vendor/service provider Start a paid tier POST /subscriptions/cancel vendor/service provider Cancel the current subscription POST /subscriptions/upgrade vendor/service provider Move to a higher tier POST /subscriptions/downgrade vendor/service provider Schedule a downgrade to a lower tier GET /subscriptions/vendor/:vendorId/limits JWT Listing limits for a vendor GET /subscriptions/all superAdmin List all subscriptions GET /subscriptions/my Returns the current subscription (or the default free shape), the tier's limits, the user's current product/service count and the applicable price list. <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "subscription": { "id": "...", "userId": "...", "type": "vendor", "tier": "pro", "price": 25000, "startDate": "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z", "endDate": "2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z", "isActive": true, "isTrial": false, "paymentMethod": "manual" }, "limits": { "products": 50, "services": 15 }, "currentCount": 12, "prices": { "free": 0, "pro": 25000, "business": 75000, "enterprise": 150000 } } </CodeBlock POST /subscriptions/subscribe Starts a paid subscription for the authenticated account. Body: json { "tier": "pro", "paymentMethod": "clickpesa" } tier is required and must be one of free, pro, business, enterprise; paymentMethod defaults to manual when omitted. Returns 201 with the created subscription. Subscribing to the tier you already hold returns 400. <Callout type="warning" subscribe and upgrade are gated by paymentEnabled('subscription'). When the payment service (ClickPesa) is switched off or subscription payments are paused, these endpoints return 503 and no subscription is created. </Callout POST /subscriptions/upgrade Move to a higher-priced tier. Same body as subscribe (tier, optional paymentMethod). Returns 400 with Use downgradeTier for tier downgrades when the target tier is not strictly more expensive. The previous subscription is deactivated and a new one is created at the full new-tier price. POST /subscriptions/downgrade Schedule a move to a cheaper tier. Same body as subscribe. Returns 400 with Use upgradeTier for tier upgrades when the target tier is not strictly cheaper. The downgraded subscription is created with isActive: false and autoDowngrade: true and takes effect at the current subscription's endDate. <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "message": "Downgrade to free scheduled for 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z", "subscription": { "tier": "free", "price": 0, "isActive": false, "autoDowngrade": true, "startDate": "2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z" } } </CodeBlock POST /subscriptions/cancel Deactivates the active subscription immediately. Returns 404 when there is no active subscription. GET /subscriptions/vendor/:vendorId/limits Returns the subscription limits for a vendor's business profile (vendorId is the business profile id). Includes the tier, the products/services caps, the current product count and canAddMore. <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "tier": "business", "limits": { "products": 200, "services": 50 }, "currentCount": 47, "canAddMore": true } </CodeBlock Returns 404 when the vendor is not found. GET /subscriptions/all superAdmin only. Lists every subscription, newest first, with the owning user's id, fullName and email. Filter with query params type (vendor service provider), tier and isActive (true false). <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "subscriptions": [ { "id": "...", "type": "vendor", "tier": "pro", "price": 25000, "isActive": true, "user": { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane@example.com" } } ], "total": 1 } </CodeBlock

title: Users
description: Reference for /api/user and /api/business — profiles, addresses, and business management.
text: User and business endpoints manage profiles and the vendor/provider business records. All user endpoints below require a JWT. GET /user/profile Current user profile. Auth required. Returns the user object as a flat JSON body (not wrapped in {status, data}) with businessProfile and the default address included. <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "email": "you@example.com", "role": "vendor", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000", "avatarUrl": "...", "businessProfile": { "businessName": "Jane's Shop", "status": "APPROVED" }, "addresses": [ { "id": "...", "label": "Home", "streetAddress": "...", "city": "...", "isDefault": true } ] } </CodeBlock GET /auth/me Full "who am I" payload. Auth required. The richest current-user endpoint: it resolves businessProfile (including its university and region), the user's own university, region, majorAdminRegion and adminPermissions, and adds selfieVerification and firstName. <CodeBlock title="Response shape" json { "id": "...", "fullName": "Jane Doe", "role": "vendor", "businessProfile": { "businessName": "Jane's Shop", "university": { "id": "...", "name": "..." }, "region": { "id": "...", "name": "..." } }, "university": { "id": "...", "name": "..." }, "region": { "id": "...", "name": "..." }, "majorAdminRegion": { "region": { "id": "...", "name": "..." } }, "adminPermissions": [{ "permissionKey": "manage orders", "enabled": true }], "selfieVerification": { "status": "..." }, "firstName": "Jane" } </CodeBlock PUT /user/update Update name, phone and address fields. Also syncs the default address: it updates the existing default when one exists, or creates one labelled Home when streetAddress and city are both provided. <CodeBlock title="Request" json { "fullName": "Jane Doe", "phoneNumber": "+255700000000", "streetAddress": "123 Sam Nujoma Road", "district": "Kinondoni", "ward": "Mikocheni", "city": "Dar es Salaam" } </CodeBlock PUT /user/avatar Upload a new avatar image (multipart, field name avatar). Returns the updated avatarUrl. PUT /user/password <CodeBlock title="Request" json { "currentPassword": "old", "newPassword": "new" } </CodeBlock Returns 401 with Invalid current password when the current password is wrong. Addresses (/api/user/addresses) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /user/addresses JWT List your addresses (soft-deleted excluded) POST /user/addresses JWT Create an address (see body below) DELETE /user/addresses/:id JWT Soft-delete an address <CodeBlock title="POST /user/addresses" json { "label": "Home", "streetAddress": "123 Sam Nujoma Road", "city": "Dar es Salaam", "district": "Kinondoni", "ward": "Mikocheni", "isDefault": true } </CodeBlock Setting isDefault: true clears isDefault on the user's other addresses. Payment methods (/api/user/payments) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /user/payments JWT List saved payment methods POST /user/payments JWT Save a payment method <CodeBlock title="POST /user/payments" json { "type": "mobile money", "provider": "M-Pesa", "accountNumber": "+255700000000", "isDefault": true } </CodeBlock DELETE /user/account Soft-deletes your own account: sets deletedAt while preserving the data in records. Auth required. Role changes & activity logs - PUT /users/change-role and GET /users/activity-logs do not exist . Role changes are performed by admins only via PUT /admin/users/:userId/role (protected by partnerAdmin/majorAdmin/superAdmin and scoped to region). Activity logs are admin-only via GET /admin/activity. - Referral info lives in the referrals API: GET /referrals/my, GET /referrals/code and POST /referrals/apply. Business endpoints (/api/business) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /business/all Public Approved businesses with counts GET /business/:id Public Business detail + products + services PUT /business/update vendor+ Upsert business profile PUT /business/logo vendor+ Upload logo PUT /business/cover vendor+ Upload cover image GET /business/verification-status vendor+ Live approval status <Callout type="note" Business status must be APPROVED before the owner can list products or services. </Callout

title: Architecture overview
description: How the SokoPlus frontend, backend, database and services fit together.
text: SokoPlus is a full-stack application split across a frontend SPA and a backend API. System diagram text ┌──────────────┐ HTTPS ┌──────────────────┐ │ Frontend │ ──────────────▶ │ Backend API │ │ React 19 │ JSON / JWT │ Express 5 │ │ TanStack SSR │ ◀────────────── │ (REST /api/ ) │ └──────────────┘ JSON └────────┬─────────┘ │ ┌───────────┼───────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │PostgreSQL│ │ Redis │ │ClickPesa │ │ (Prisma) │ │ (cache) │ │ (payments)│ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ Backend layout src/ ├── app.js Entry: middleware pipeline, route mounting ├── controllers/ 40 route handler modules ├── routes/ 35 route definition files ├── middleware/ auth, validation, feature guards, rate limiting, errors ├── lib/ db, clickpesa, email, cloudinary, logger, socket, etc. └── services/ escrow, commission, credit, referral, subscription, push Key design decisions - Express 5 + plain JavaScript — fast iteration, ESM throughout. - Prisma 7 + PrismaPg adapter — typed ORM over PostgreSQL, hot-reload safe singleton. - Zod schemas (shared package) — request validation on mutations. - JWT + RBAC middleware — protect + authorize(...roles) on every protected route. - HMAC webhooks — ClickPesa callbacks are checksum-verified, so payment events are trusted. - Feature flags — the PlatformSetting table (ecommerce:<key ) can disable features globally. Frontend ↔ backend contract The frontend talks to the backend only through the REST API. There is no direct database access from the client. All communication is JSON over HTTPS. Data flow example — placing an order 1. Frontend adds items to the cart (POST /cart/add). 2. Checkout (POST /orders/checkout) validates stock, delivery and working hours. 3. Payment is initiated via ClickPesa (POST /payments/initiate). 4. The ClickPesa webhook confirms the payment and updates the transaction. 5. The order moves to pending and the vendor is notified. Real-time - socket.io pushes live events (e.g. payment confirmations) to connected clients. - Web push / Expo push deliver notifications to browsers and devices. - The frontend also polls key resources as a fallback.

title: Authentication
description: How JWT, OTP and Google sign-in work on the SokoPlus API, and how to keep sessions secure.
text: SokoPlus uses JWT bearer tokens for all authenticated requests. Tokens are issued after login, OTP verification, or Google sign-in. Getting a token Email + password login bash curl -X POST https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/auth/login \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "password": "secret"}' <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "status": "success", "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...", "user": { "id": "...", "email": "you@example.com", "role": "client" } } } </CodeBlock OTP (registration & recovery) 1. POST /auth/signup with your details → sends a 6-digit code. 2. POST /auth/otp/verify with the code → returns a JWT for new users. 3. Password reset uses the same flow: /auth/forgot-password/send → /verify → /reset. Google sign-in POST /auth/google with the Google OAuth token from your web client ID. Using the token Send it on every authenticated request: bash curl https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/user/profile \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token " Auth endpoints Method Path Description -------- ------ ------------- POST /auth/signup Start registration (sends OTP) POST /auth/login Email + password login POST /auth/otp/send Send verification OTP POST /auth/otp/verify Verify OTP (returns JWT if new user) POST /auth/otp/link Link a phone number to an account POST /auth/google Google OAuth sign-in POST /auth/logout Invalidate the session POST /auth/refresh Refresh a token POST /auth/forgot-password/send Send reset OTP POST /auth/forgot-password/verify Verify reset code POST /auth/forgot-password/reset Set a new password GET /auth/me Current user profile (with business) POST /auth/check-exists Check whether a user exists Token validation The protect middleware: - Decodes the JWT from the Authorization header. - Loads the user from the database. - Rejects users who are soft-deleted, suspended or disqualified. - Attaches the user to req.user. <Callout type="warning" 401 responses mean your token is missing, expired or the user is blocked. Re-authenticate to continue. </Callout Role-based access control is applied on top of JWT auth across the API.

title: ClickPesa integration
description: How SokoPlus integrates ClickPesa for payments and payouts, including the HMAC checksum.
text: SokoPlus uses ClickPesa as its payment gateway (https://api.clickpesa.com/third-parties). Gateway credentials Environment variable Purpose ---------------------- --------- CLICKPESA CLIENT ID Gateway client ID CLICKPESA API KEY API key CLICKPESA CHECKSUM KEY HMAC signing key CLICKPESA WEBHOOK SECRET Webhook verification CLICKPESA MODE sandbox or production Creating a payment intent The backend builds a signed request body and calls the ClickPesa API to initiate a payment for an order, subscription or boost. The canonical JSON body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the checksum key. Verification Incoming webhooks and responses are verified by recomputing the HMAC over the canonical request body and comparing checksums. Only verified callbacks are trusted. Payouts Payouts follow the same pattern: an intent is created with the vendor's payout details, and the result is confirmed through the payout webhook. <Callout type="warning" Keep CLICKPESA secrets out of client code and out of public repositories. They belong only in server environment variables. </Callout Current gateway note The platform currently records transactions with gateway: 'other' internally while routing through ClickPesa. If you read PaymentGateway values, expect 'other' today. Next - See Webhooks for the callback contract. - The full environment-variable reference is available to platform admins only.

title: Data model
description: The core Prisma models behind SokoPlus — users, commerce, money and operations.
text: SokoPlus stores everything in PostgreSQL and models it with Prisma . This page covers the core models. Identity & roles Model Purpose ------- --------- User Account with a Role enum, verification flags, soft-delete BusinessProfile Vendor/provider business record, 1:1 with a user, has a status DeliveryPerson Delivery team members linked to a business + user Region / University Tanzania regions and campus contexts Commerce Model Purpose ------- --------- Product Physical goods with price, stock, metrics, soft-delete. Images live on the product as an imageUrl string array (no separate image model) ProductVariant / WholesaleTier / ProductSpecification Product variants (type, name, price, stock, SKU), bulk-pricing tiers and spec key/value pairs Service Professional services with base price Category Single shared category tree for products and services (hierarchical via parentId, typed via type) Order / OrderItem / OrderSuborder Orders split per business with per-suborder delivery data, recipient codes and QR payloads CartItem Cart line items (product + optional variant). The cart itself is frontend-held Booking Service bookings with accept/reject + booking code Money Model Purpose ------- --------- Transaction Payment records (status, gateway) PaymentMethod Saved payment instruments per user Payout Vendor payouts Escrow Held funds between payment and confirmation Commission Platform commission per order Refund Refund request linked to an order Credit / CreditTransaction Referral/credit balances VendorBalance / VendorBalanceLog Vendor earnings balance + ledger Subscription Vendor tier plans ServiceBoost / ProductBoost Promoted listings Coupon Discount codes FlashSale (+ FlashSaleParticipant) Time-limited deals Referral Referral links and rewards Communication Model Purpose ------- --------- Message Direct messages between users Notification System notifications SupportTicket Customer support threads CustomerReport Bug/complaint/feature reports Feedback / Review Rated feedback with moderation WebPushSubscription Browser push subscriptions — id, userId, endpoint, p256dh, auth, createdAt; one row per user+browser (@@unique([userId, endpoint])), cascade-deleted with the user Operations Model Purpose ------- --------- PlatformSetting Key-value config (incl. ecommerce feature flags) PlatformContent CMS pages (privacy, terms) FAQ Frequently asked questions ActivityLog Audit trail AdminPermission Per-admin permission toggles OtpCode One-time passwords TokenBlacklist Revoked tokens WorkingHours Business schedules DeliveryZone Delivery areas + fees ShowcaseProject Promoted external projects Suborders An Order can contain items from several vendors in one checkout. At creation it is split into one OrderSuborder per business ; each suborder owns its own fulfilment lifecycle: Field Purpose ------- --------- orderId / businessId Parent order and owning business subtotal Sum of that business's items status Own OrderStatus value per suborder recipientCode Unique code for the 3-way delivery verification of this suborder negotiatedAmount / collectedAmount Negotiated price and cash collected on handover hasDelivery / deliveryCost Delivery flag + fee per suborder deliveryPersonId / deliveryVerified / deliveryVerifiedAt Assignment + verified handover deliveryLocation / deliveryLat / deliveryLng GPS handover point cancelledAt / cancelReason When and why the suborder was cancelled A single order may therefore show multiple statuses and recipient codes at once. The delivery QR payload encodes the suborder: { v:1, o:<suborderId , r:<recipientCode , s:1 } — verify endpoints accept suborderId + recipientId to target the right suborder. Order-level fields also exist for legacy/single-vendor flows and order-wide accounting: Field Purpose ------- --------- deliveryVerified / recipientId Legacy single-vendor delivery verification negotiatedAmount / collectedAmount Order-wide negotiated price and collected cash cancelReason Why the order was cancelled OrderItem rows snapshot the product at purchase time (productId, productName, productPrice, quantity, imageUrl) plus the selected variant (variantId, variantName, variantType) and any selectedSpecs / notes. Every item is linked to the owning suborder via suborderId. Endpoints that act on one business's share (/orders/:id/status, /orders/:id/verify-recipient, /delivery/assign, /delivery/:id/verify) accept an optional suborderId to target the correct suborder. Soft delete pattern Most models have deletedAt + deletedBy. Deleting sets those fields; normal queries exclude them. Admins can restore or permanently remove via /admin/records. Enums Enum Values ------ -------- Role client, vendor, service provider, delivery, partnerAdmin, majorAdmin, superAdmin PaymentStatus unpaid, paid, refunded, partial TransactionStatus pending, success, failed, refunded, held, released PayoutStatus pending, processing, completed, failed PaymentGateway selcom, stripe, tigo pesa, mpesa, airtel money, bank transfer, clickpesa, other EscrowStatus held, released, refunded, expired SubscriptionTier free, pro, business, enterprise SubscriptionType vendor, service provider BoostType pin, featured, spotlight Business and order statuses are plain string fields , not Prisma enums: BusinessProfile.status uses APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED, SUSPENDED; Order.status and OrderSuborder.status use pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled (returned is also accepted via the admin route). <Callout type="note" The exact Prisma schema lives in the backend repository under prisma/schema.prisma — treat this page as a summary. </Callout

title: Feature flags (ecommerce controls)
description: The PlatformSetting-driven feature flags that enable or disable platform capabilities globally.
text: SokoPlus can disable whole features at runtime using feature flags stored in PlatformSetting under keys like ecommerce:<feature . How they work - Each flag has enabled and an optional message. - The featureEnabled(key) middleware returns 503 with { message, feature, enabled: false } when a feature is off. god mode bypasses every guard; maintenance mode is applied app-wide but exempts /api/auth, /api/admin and /health. - Flags are managed by superAdmin via GET /admin/ecommerce (list all) and GET/PUT /admin/ecommerce/:id (read/toggle one). The public GET /admin/ecommerce/public exposes the same list without admin auth (no message). Flag list Key Controls Default ----- ---------- --------- ordering Placing orders enabled registration New user registration enabled vendor signup Vendor registration enabled service provider signup Service provider registration enabled product listing Listing products enabled service listing Listing services enabled checkout Checkout flow enabled wishlist Wishlist enabled reviews Reviews enabled vendor verification Require vendor verification enabled commission Commission tracking enabled refunds Refunds enabled messaging Messaging enabled notifications Notifications enabled maintenance mode Maintenance mode disabled featured products Featured products enabled god mode SuperAdmin bypass disabled payment service Digital payment processing (ClickPesa) disabled subscription Vendor subscriptions enabled boosts Product/service boosts enabled flash sales Flash sales enabled coupons Coupons enabled referral credits Referrals & credits enabled The table follows ECOMMERCE CONTROLS in adminController.js. There is no discounts enabled control. Server-side enforcement Most flags are also enforced in the route layer with featureEnabled(...), so disabling a feature returns 503 from the API itself — not just a hidden UI element: - subscription — all /api/subscriptions endpoints (my, subscribe, cancel, upgrade, downgrade, all). - boosts — service boost listing and purchase (GET /api/services/my/boosts, POST /api/services/boost). - coupons — create, update, delete, list-mine, validate and apply (/api/coupons/ ). - flash sales — vendor join (POST /api/flash-sales/join/:flashSaleId). - referral credits — referral endpoints (/api/referrals/my, /api/referrals/stats, /api/referrals/code, /api/referrals/apply) and credit endpoints (/api/credits/my, /api/credits/history, /api/credits/redeem). Payment service off = Cash on Delivery payment service is the master switch for digital payments only. When it is disabled: - Online payments are off — payment-gated money features (subscriptions, boosts, coupon redemption, payouts, credits) return 503 with "Digital payments are currently offline. Cash on delivery only." - Ordering and checkout stay available — ordering and checkout are independent flags. Checkout bypasses the payment-service gate so orders can still be placed. - Checkout returns requiresPayment: false and the order is placed as Cash on Delivery : the delivery agent collects on delivery, and escrow is still created (default) and released per suborder on verification. See Orders, cart & bookings for the checkout response shape. Audiences Audience Notified on toggle ---------- -------------------- all All users businesses Vendors + service providers none Nobody (silent) Example bash Disable ordering platform-wide curl -X PUT https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/admin/ecommerce/ordering \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <superadmin-token " \ -d '{"enabled": false, "message": "Ordering is temporarily paused."}' <Callout type="warning" Toggling maintenance mode or god mode can block real user activity. Disabling payment service stops all online payments but keeps COD ordering available. Use with care. </Callout

title: Escrow & commissions
description: How escrow protects transactions and how platform commissions are tracked.
text: Two mechanisms keep money movement fair: escrow and commissions . Escrow (/api/escrow) Escrow holds funds until delivery is confirmed. Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- GET /escrow/status/:orderId JWT Escrow status for an order POST /escrow/initiate-release admin Release funds to vendor POST /escrow/initiate-refund admin Return funds to buyer POST /escrow/confirm admin Confirm a release/refund POST /escrow/process-expired superAdmin Sweep expired escrows Escrow lifecycle 1. Created — when the order payment webhook is confirmed. 2. Held — funds sit until the order is delivered and confirmed. 3. Released — funds go to the vendor after receipt confirmation. 4. Refunded — funds return to the buyer when a refund is approved. Commissions The platform charges a commission on orders (tracked on the Commission model). Field Description ------- ------------- businessId The vendor receiving the order orderId Related order amount Commission amount rate Commission rate status Pending / paid - Commissions are listed under GET /admin/commissions (superAdmin). - Mark as paid via PUT /admin/commissions/:id/pay. <Callout type="note" Commission tracking can be enabled or disabled via the commission feature flag. </Callout The full money flow text Buyer pays ──▶ Escrow held ──▶ Delivery confirmed ──▶ Released to vendor │ └──▶ Commission recorded ──▶ Paid out Next - See Payments overview. - See Feature flags for commission controls.

title: Introduction
description: An overview of the SokoPlus platform API — what it is, the stack, and who it's for.
text: This documentation covers the SokoPlus platform: its public API , the data model , and the concepts behind the marketplace. It's intended for developers building on top of SokoPlus or integrating their own systems. The platform at a glance - Frontend: React 19 + TanStack Start (SSR), Tailwind CSS v4, bilingual EN/SW - Backend: Node.js + Express 5 (ESM) - Database: PostgreSQL 17 via Prisma 7 - Auth: JWT (bearer) + OTP + Google OAuth, role-based access control - Payments: ClickPesa with HMAC-verified webhooks - Realtime: socket.io + push notifications (web-push + Expo) The API The REST API is mounted under /api. All responses are JSON. Mutations generally require authentication, and role-based middleware enforces who can call what. <Callout type="note" Throughout these docs, the base URL is shown as https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api. Your actual environment may differ — check your deployment configuration. </Callout What you'll find here Section Contents --------- ---------- Quick start The fastest way to get a working integration Authentication JWT, OTP, Google sign-in, roles & permissions API reference Endpoint-by-endpoint documentation grouped by resource Payments & webhooks ClickPesa, escrow, commissions, webhook signing Platform concepts Data model, feature flags, notifications Deployment Running the backend, environment variables A word on stability The platform is actively developed. Endpoint paths are stable, but response fields may evolve. Watch the updated dates on each page and keep an eye on the changelog.

title: Notifications & push
description: How system notifications and push messaging work — Expo push, web push, preferences.
text: Notifications keep users in the loop. The backend delivers them through three channels: in-app , Expo push (mobile), and web push (browser). Channels Channel Mechanism When --------- ----------- ------ In-app Notification rows + socket.io emit Always Expo push expoPushToken on the user, expo-server-sdk Mobile apps Web push WebPushSubscription + web-push library (VAPID) Browser Registering for push bash Mobile (Expo token) curl -X PUT https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/notifications/update-expo-token \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token " \ -d '{"expoPushToken": "ExponentPushToken[...]"}' Web (push subscription) curl -X POST https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/notifications/register-token \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token " \ -d '{"subscription": {"endpoint": "...", "keys": {"auth": "...", "p256dh": "..."}}}' Preferences Users can mute notification types via GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences. Preference Controls ------------ ---------- order updates Order status, delivery, escrow promotions Promos, boosts, coupons general Everything else What triggers a notification - Order placed / status changed - Delivery assigned / verified - New message - Vendor approval / rejection - Payment or refund events - Feature flag toggles (broadcast by audience) Sending broadcasts (admin) Method Path Description -------- ------ ------------- POST /api/notifications/notify-all Notify every user POST /api/notifications/notify-vendor Notify all vendors <Callout type="note" notify-all can be expensive — it fans out to every registered token. Use sparingly. </Callout Security notes - Never log expoPushToken or VAPID private keys. - VAPID keys belong in env vars (VAPID PUBLIC KEY, VAPID PRIVATE KEY). - Respect user preferences before sending promotional pushes.

title: Payments overview
description: The payment flow on SokoPlus — intents, payouts, and how money moves.
text: Payments on SokoPlus go through a payment gateway (ClickPesa). The flow is split into initiate (you create a payment intent) and confirm (the gateway webhook tells us it succeeded). Payment endpoints (/api/payments) Method Path Auth Description -------- ------ ------ ------------- POST /payments/initiate JWT Create a payment intent (order) POST /payments/initiate-payout admin Initiate vendor payout GET /payments/payout-status vendor Check payout status GET /payments/vendor-balance vendor Vendor earnings balance POST /payments/purchase-subscription vendor Buy subscription POST /payments/purchase-boost vendor Buy service boost POST /payments/purchase-product-boost vendor Buy product boost The order payment flow 1. Checkout — POST /orders/checkout creates the order with a payment intent. 2. Initiate — POST /payments/initiate creates a gateway payment for the order. 3. Gateway — the buyer completes payment (mobile money, card, etc.). 4. Webhook — ClickPesa calls /api/clickpesa/payment with the result. 5. Confirm — the backend updates the transaction and order, and creates the escrow record. Payouts Vendor earnings accumulate as a balance. Payouts are initiated by admins and confirmed via the ClickPesa payout webhook. <Callout type="note" All transactions record a TransactionStatus, PaymentStatus and PaymentGateway so the money trail is auditable. </Callout Transaction model Key fields: Field Description ------- ------------- amount Amount in TZS status Transaction status paymentStatus Payment status gateway Gateway used orderId Related order (nullable) type Order / subscription / boost Next - See ClickPesa integration for gateway specifics. - See Webhooks for how callbacks are verified.

title: Quick start
description: The fastest path to a working SokoPlus API integration — base URL, auth, first requests.
text: Here's the fastest path to making your first authenticated request. 1. Get the base URL All API calls use: text https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api 2. Health check Confirm the API is reachable: bash curl https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/health <CodeBlock title="Response" json { "status": "ok", "database": "connected" } </CodeBlock 3. Register or log in To get a token, register a user and verify the OTP, or log in with an existing account: bash curl -X POST https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/auth/login \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "password": "your-password"}' <CodeBlock title="Response (truncated)" json { "status": "success", "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..." } } </CodeBlock 4. Call an authenticated endpoint Send the token as a bearer header: bash curl https://api.sokopluss.co.tz/api/user/profile \ -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..." 5. Explore public endpoints No token needed for these: Endpoint Purpose ---------- --------- GET /products/all List products GET /services/all List services GET /business/all List verified businesses GET /categories List categories GET /explore Marketplace discovery Common headers Header Value When -------- ------- ------ Authorization Bearer <jwt All authenticated requests Content-Type application/json All JSON bodies <Callout type="warning" Keep your JWT secret on the client secure. Do not expose tokens in public repositories. </Callout Next step: understand how authentication works.

title: Rate limits & security
description: API rate limiting, input validation, and the security headers applied by the SokoPlus backend.
text: The backend applies several layers of protection to every request. Rate limiting Rate limits are applied globally and on sensitive paths: Limiter Scope Limit --------- ------- ------- globalLimiter All /api/ requests 200 per 15 minutes authLimiter All /api/auth/ requests 20 per 15 minutes userStrictLimiter Non-GET requests 30 per minute <CodeBlock title="429 response" json { "status": "error", "message": "Too many requests, please try again later." } </CodeBlock <Callout type="tip" Respect Retry-After headers and back off exponentially instead of retrying immediately. </Callout Input validation - Zod schemas (from the shared @trustflow/shared package) validate request bodies on mutations. - Legacy express-validator chains remain in src/middleware/validate.js. - Invalid input returns 400 Bad Request with field errors. Security headers (Helmet) Helmet sets headers to prevent common attacks: - X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection - Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy guidance - Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy CORS Only whitelisted origins (from CORS ORIGIN / CORS ORIGIN2) can call the API from browsers. Everything else is blocked. Other protections - Input sanitization — the frontend strips HTML from outgoing data. - Soft deletes — destructive actions set deletedAt instead of removing rows. - Activity logging — admin actions are recorded for audit. - Feature guards — disabled features return 503 with a configurable message.

title: Webhooks
description: How ClickPesa payment and payout webhooks work, and how the backend verifies them.
text: Webhooks are the gateway's way of telling the backend that a payment or payout finished. They are unauthenticated HTTP endpoints secured by checksum verification instead. Endpoints Endpoint Purpose ---------- --------- POST /api/clickpesa/payment Payment result POST /api/clickpesa/payout Payout result Verification flow 1. ClickPesa sends a JSON body plus a checksum. 2. The backend recomputes the HMAC-SHA256 signature over the canonical body using CLICKPESA CHECKSUM KEY. 3. If the checksums match, the event is processed. 4. Otherwise the webhook is rejected. <CodeBlock title="Pseudocode" js const expected = hmacSHA256(canonicalJson(body), CHECKSUM KEY) if (headerChecksum !== expected) return res.status(401).end() </CodeBlock Payment webhook effects On a verified payment: - The Transaction is updated (status, payment status, references). - The related order is updated. - An escrow record is created for the order. - Subscriptions / service boosts are activated when their payments arrive. - The user is notified via socket.io / push. <Callout type="warning" Idempotency matters — handle duplicate webhook deliveries gracefully (e.g. check transaction status before re-processing). </Callout Configuring your own webhooks Your integration should: 1. Expose a URL ClickPesa can reach. 2. Verify the checksum on every callback before trusting it. 3. Respond quickly (2xx) so the gateway doesn't retry. 4. Reconcile with your transaction records. Next - See ClickPesa integration. - See Escrow & commissions for what happens after payment.

title: Account verification
description: How email, phone and business verification work on SokoPlus, and why they matter for trust.
text: SokoPlus is built on trust. Verification confirms that accounts belong to real people and real businesses. Email verification - A 6-digit code is sent to your email when you register. - Enter the code to activate your account. - If your email changes later, you'll be asked to verify the new address. Phone verification - A 6-digit code is sent via SMS to your phone. - Entering the code links your phone number to your account. - You can also link a phone number to an existing account later from your profile settings. Business (ID) verification For vendors and service providers, an admin reviews your business application. The review covers your business details and, in some cases, ID documentation. Status Meaning -------- --------- Pending Your application is waiting for review. Approved Your business is live and can list products or services. Rejected Your application was declined. You'll usually receive a reason. Suspended Your business was suspended by an admin. <Callout type="warning" You cannot list products or services until your business status is Approved . </Callout Why verification matters - Buyers can trust they are dealing with real businesses. - The platform can hold sellers accountable through feedback and reports. - It reduces fraud, fake listings and lost deliveries. Forgot your password? Use the Forgot password link on the login screen — you'll receive an OTP by email to reset it.

title: Becoming a delivery partner
description: How delivery partners are created, how to use the delivery app, and how to manage your availability.
text: Delivery partners are the people who carry out deliveries for vendors on SokoPlus. How you become a delivery partner Delivery partners are created by vendors . When a vendor adds a member to their delivery team, the system automatically creates a delivery account for them with login credentials. 1. Your vendor creates your account with your name, phone and email. 2. You receive login details to share (the vendor provides them). 3. Log in to the SokoPlus app and start accepting deliveries. <Callout type="note" If you're an individual looking to deliver, contact vendors you'd like to work with — they can add you to their delivery team. </Callout Your delivery dashboard As a delivery partner you have a focused dashboard: - Overview — stats and pending deliveries - Packages — all assigned deliveries with the verification flow - Profile — your info, availability toggle, and password change Availability Toggle your status active or offline from your profile. When active, vendors can assign deliveries to you. Notifications You'll be notified when a vendor assigns you a delivery. Keep notifications enabled so you don't miss jobs. Ready to make a delivery? See Completing deliveries & ID verification.

title: Becoming a service provider
description: How to register as a service provider, set up your profile and offer professional services on SokoPlus.
text: Service providers offer professional services — repairs, design, technical support, photography, logistics and more — to clients across Tanzania. 1. Register as a service provider Register with the Service provider role. Like vendors, your account starts as pending until your business is approved. 2. Complete your business profile From your dashboard, open the Business tab: - Business name and description - Contact details (email, WhatsApp, phone) - Address and location - Business registration / tax numbers (optional) - Logo and cover image 3. Get approved An admin reviews your application. You can check your verification status live from the Business tab. <Callout type="warning" You cannot list services until your business status is Approved . </Callout 4. List your services Once approved: - Add services with a title, description, base price, banner image and category. - Set your working hours so clients know when you're available. - Manage bookings as they come in. Service provider checklist - [ ] Account approved - [ ] Business profile complete - [ ] At least one service listed - [ ] Working hours set Ready to list services? See Managing services.

title: Becoming a vendor
description: How to register as a vendor, set up your business profile and get approved to sell on SokoPlus.
text: Becoming a vendor on SokoPlus lets you sell physical products to buyers across Tanzania. 1. Register as a vendor Register with the Vendor role. Your account starts as pending until your business is approved. 2. Complete your business profile From your dashboard, open the Business tab and fill in: - Business name - Business email, WhatsApp and office phone - Address (city, district, ward, landmark) - Website URL (optional) - Business registration number (optional) - Tax number (optional) - Year established - Logo and cover image - Default delivery fee 3. Get approved An admin reviews your application. You can check your verification status live from the Business tab. <Callout type="warning" You cannot list products until your business status is Approved . </Callout 4. Set up shop Once approved: - Add your products (name, price, stock, unit, images). - Set up your delivery zones and fees. - Add delivery team members if you plan to fulfil orders yourself. - Set your working hours . Vendor checklist - [ ] Account approved - [ ] Business profile complete - [ ] At least one product listed - [ ] Delivery zones configured - [ ] Working hours set Ready to list products? See Managing products.

title: Completing deliveries & ID verification
description: The delivery handover process — how to verify a recipient and mark an order delivered.
text: Completing a delivery correctly is the most important part of your job. SokoPlus uses a 3-way verification system to make sure every order reaches the right person. The handover flow 1. A vendor assigns a delivery to you — the order moves to shipped . 2. You receive the package and head to the delivery address. 3. At the location, verify the recipient ID or scan the QR code . 4. Confirm the delivery — the order is marked delivered . Verifying a recipient - The order has a recipient ID generated when the vendor confirmed it. - Ask the recipient for their recipient ID and enter it, or - Scan the QR code on the order using the built-in scanner. - Only confirm the delivery once you've verified the handover. <Callout type="danger" Never mark an order as delivered unless you have physically handed it to the recipient and verified their ID. Doing otherwise releases payment and can lead to disputes. </Callout Recipient confirmations The buyer can also confirm receipt themselves from their Orders tab. Either way, the delivery only completes after verification. If you can't find the recipient - Try contacting the buyer through the app. - If you can't complete the delivery, notify the vendor so they can help. - Don't leave the package unattended without agreement. Your stats Your dashboard shows your delivery history and stats — completed deliveries, and your active/offline status. Keeping your stats strong helps vendors trust you with more jobs.

title: Coupons, credits & referrals
description: How to use discount coupons, earn credits, and benefit from the referral program on SokoPlus.
text: SokoPlus rewards participation with coupons, credits and referrals. Using a coupon 1. When you have a coupon code, enter it in the coupon field at checkout . 2. The discount is applied to your order if the coupon is valid. 3. Coupons may have conditions — minimum order amount, maximum discount, and an expiry date. <Callout type="note" Not all orders qualify for every coupon. Check the terms shown for the code before checkout. </Callout Where coupons come from - Vendors create coupons to promote their shops. - The platform occasionally runs coupon promotions. - Coupons have a limited number of uses. Platform credits Credits are a balance on your account that can be spent or redeemed toward purchases at checkout. - View your credit balance in your dashboard. - See your credit history (earned and redeemed). - Redeem credits when you check out. Referrals Refer new users to SokoPlus: 1. Share your referral link/code with friends and colleagues. 2. When a friend signs up with your code, they get a 2,000 credit signup bonus , and you earn 5,000 credits once they become active. 3. Credits accumulate in your balance and can be redeemed at checkout. <Callout type="warning" Referral credit is only earned for genuine new users. Spam or self-referrals may be rejected by the system. </Callout Where to find these - Coupons you've created (vendors) are under your shop's coupon section. - Credits and referrals are visible in your dashboard balance and referral sections.

title: Creating your account
description: How to register on SokoPlus as a buyer, vendor or service provider, including OTP email and phone verification.
text: Creating an account is free and takes a few minutes. Registration is a multi-step flow where you choose your role and verify your email and phone number. Step-by-step 1. Open the SokoPlus app and tap Register . 2. Choose your role: - Client — you want to buy products and book services. - Vendor — you want to sell physical products. - Service provider — you want to offer professional services. 3. Fill in your details: full name, email, password, and phone number. 4. Choose your region and location from the 31 Tanzanian regions. 5. Complete the email OTP verification — we send a 6-digit code to your inbox. 6. Complete the phone OTP verification — we send a 6-digit code via SMS. 7. Your account is created. Clients become active immediately; vendors and providers start as pending until an admin approves their business. What you need - A valid email address you can access - A phone number you can receive SMS on - Your location details (region, district, ward) <Callout type="tip" Vendors and service providers: have your business details ready — business name, registration number (if you have one), and your address. You'll add these when setting up your business profile. </Callout After registration - Clients can start browsing the marketplace immediately. - Vendors and providers see a Pending Approval screen until their business application is reviewed. - You can update your profile, avatar, and notification preferences anytime from your dashboard. Can't find the verification email? Check your spam folder. If you requested a new code, wait for the resend timer before requesting again. Still stuck? Contact support from the Support page.

title: Managing your delivery team
description: How vendors create delivery partner accounts, set delivery zones and track deliveries.
text: Your delivery team carries out the deliveries for your shop. Manage them from the Delivery Team tab. Adding a delivery person 1. Open Delivery Team → Add member . 2. Enter their full name, phone number and email. 3. The system creates a delivery account for them automatically, with login details you can share. Managing your team - Activate / deactivate a member to make them available or offline. - Edit their details at any time. - Remove a member who leaves. <Callout type="tip" Share the login email and password hint securely with your delivery person so they can access their delivery app. </Callout Delivery zones Set the areas you can deliver to and the fee for each zone: 1. Open Delivery Zones . 2. Add a zone with its location name , delivery fee , and estimated time . 3. Buyers in that zone see your delivery options at checkout. The platform can also calculate a delivery fee for a given location, falling back to your business default if no zone matches. Assigning deliveries From an order, assign a delivery partner. The partner: - Sees the job in their app. - Carries out the recipient ID / QR verification at handover. - Marks the order delivered. Tracking performance - The delivery partner's stats are visible to them in their app. - You can see delivery progress on each order from your Orders tab.

title: Escrow protection
description: How escrow keeps buyer money safe until an order is confirmed as delivered.
text: Escrow is a money-holding mechanism that protects both buyers and sellers. How escrow works 1. You pay at checkout — your payment is recorded and held. 2. The vendor delivers — the order is shipped and handed over. 3. You confirm receipt (or the delivery partner verifies the handover). 4. Funds are released to the vendor. Why it matters for buyers - Your money is not sent directly to the vendor the moment you pay. - If the order isn't delivered correctly, the money can be returned to you instead of released. Why it matters for sellers - Once you deliver and the buyer confirms, payment is released automatically . - It removes the awkward "pay me after" conversations. Releasing funds Releases can be initiated automatically when the order is confirmed, or triggered by the admin/system where required. Refunds follow the refund approval process — see Returns & refunds. <Callout type="danger" Confirming an order as delivered releases funds to the vendor. Only confirm when you physically have your items. </Callout Payouts to vendors Vendor earnings build up as a balance and can be paid out in bulk. Vendors can check their balance and payout status in their dashboard.

title: Frequently asked questions
description: Quick answers to the most common questions about SokoPlus.
text: Accounts & registration How do I create an account? Tap Register , choose your role (client, vendor or service provider), enter your details and verify your email and phone with the OTP codes. See Creating your account. I didn't receive my verification code. Check your spam folder and wait for the resend timer. If it still doesn't arrive, contact support. Can I have more than one role? Accounts have one primary role. If you need both vendor and service provider access, talk to support about your setup. Buying How do I place an order? Add items to your cart, check out with a delivery address and payment method, then confirm. See Placing an order. How is my money protected? Payments use escrow where supported — funds are held until you confirm your order was delivered. See Escrow protection. Can I cancel an order? You can cancel an order while it is pending . Once confirmed or shipped, contact support. Selling How do I become a vendor? Register with the vendor role, complete your business profile and get approved. See Becoming a vendor. Why is my business still pending? Admins review every business application. You can check your status live in your Business tab. How do I get paid? Your earnings build up as a balance and can be paid out. Track your balance and payout status in your dashboard. Delivery How does delivery verification work? Deliveries use a recipient ID or QR code — the delivery partner verifies handover before the order is completed. See Completing deliveries. I'm a delivery partner — how do I get jobs? Vendors create delivery accounts and assign you deliveries. Keep your availability active in your profile. Payments & promotions What payment methods are supported? Cash on Delivery (COD) is used whenever online payments are off — you pay the delivery agent in cash when your items arrive. You can also save payment methods (including mobile money like ClickPesa and M-Pesa) in your dashboard when online payments are enabled. Options depend on platform settings and your region. Why can I only pay Cash on Delivery? Online payments are temporarily switched off. While they are, Cash on Delivery (COD) is the payment method: you place your order as usual and pay the delivery agent in cash on arrival. Ordering and checkout remain fully available. When online payments return, you'll have more options (saved methods, mobile money) at checkout. How do I use a coupon? Enter the code in the coupon field at checkout. See Coupons, credits & referrals. Getting help How do I contact support? Raise a support ticket from the Support page, or submit a customer report from the report button on any page.

title: Finding products & services
description: How to search, browse and filter products and services on the SokoPlus marketplace.
text: SokoPlus makes it easy to find what you need, whether it's a physical product or a professional service. Browse by category - Marketplace — browse all products with a category filter. - Services — browse professional services with their own category filter. - Explore — trending products, hot deals, new arrivals and top-rated items in one place. - Shops — browse individual verified shops by name, category or location. Search Use the search bar to find products, services and shops by name. The global search returns suggestions as you type, plus trending search terms. Filtering results On the search results page you can narrow results by: - Category - Price - Shop - Sort order (newest, price, rating) Product details Each product page shows: - Image gallery - Price (with discount price if on offer) - Stock availability - Add to cart / buy now - Related products Service details Each service page shows: - Banner image - Description - Base price - Provider information - Book button <Callout type="tip" If a shop or product is in a category you use often, save it to your Wishlist so it's easy to find again. </Callout Not finding what you need? Try the search suggestions, clear your filters, or browse a broader category. You can also submit a feature request using the report button on the site.

title: Fulfilling orders
description: How vendors confirm, ship and complete orders, including the recipient-ID handover process.
text: When a buyer places an order for your products, you manage it from the Orders tab. Order lifecycle for vendors Stage What you do ------- ------------- Pending Review the order and confirm it. Confirmation generates the recipient ID for delivery. Confirmed Prepare the items for dispatch. Shipped Assign a delivery partner (or hand over to one). The order moves to shipped. Delivered The delivery partner verifies handover with the recipient ID or QR code. Confirming an order - Open the order and tap Confirm . - The system generates a recipient ID used for the delivery handover. Assigning a delivery partner - From the order, select a member of your delivery team . - Assigning sets the order to shipped . - The delivery partner sees the job in their app. <Callout type="note" If you don't use your own delivery team, you can arrange delivery separately and update the status when the order is out. </Callout Completing the handover The delivery partner verifies the recipient ID or scans the QR code at the buyer's location. You can track this in real time. What if a buyer cancels? - If the order is still pending, the buyer can cancel it. - Once confirmed or shipped, handle cancellations with the buyer directly or via support. - Stock is restored automatically when a pending order is cancelled. Sales reporting Use the sales report (period-based) and your Analytics tab to track revenue, best sellers and order volume.

title: Language & installing the app
description: How to switch between English and Swahili, and how to install SokoPlus as a PWA on your phone.
text: SokoPlus works in English and Swahili , and it can be installed on your phone like a native app. Switching language 1. Tap the language switcher in the top bar (EN / SW). 2. Your choice is remembered for next time. The whole interface — including dashboards and notifications — switches language. Installing the app (PWA) SokoPlus is a Progressive Web App. You can install it so it appears on your home screen and works offline. Device How to install -------- ---------------- Android (Chrome) Open the site → tap the menu (⋮) → Add to Home screen iPhone (Safari) Open the site → tap the Share button → Add to Home Screen Desktop (Chrome/Edge) Open the site → tap the install icon in the address bar <Callout type="tip" Once installed, SokoPlus launches full-screen, loads faster and keeps working with a poor connection. </Callout Notifications You can enable push-style notifications in your browser or app settings. Inside the app, choose which types you want to receive: - Order updates — order status changes and deliveries - Promotions — deals and flash sales - General — platform news and messages You can turn each one on or off from your dashboard Settings tab.

title: Managing bookings
description: How service providers accept, reject and complete service bookings on SokoPlus.
text: When a client wants your service, they send a booking request . You manage it from the Bookings tab. The booking flow 1. Client finds your service and taps Book . 2. They add a message (their name, service, and details of what they need). 3. You receive the booking in your dashboard. 4. You accept or reject the request. Accepting a booking - Open the booking and review the client's message. - Tap Accept to confirm you'll do the job. - Coordinate the details (time, location) with the client directly via messaging if needed. Rejecting a booking If you can't take the job, tap Reject . This frees the client to book another provider. Booking statuses Status Meaning -------- --------- Pending Waiting for your response. Accepted You'll do the job. Rejected You declined the job. Completed The job was finished. <Callout type="tip" Respond to booking requests quickly — clients can see available providers and book elsewhere while you wait. </Callout Working hours Your working hours help clients understand when you're available. Keep them up to date — see Setting working hours.

title: Managing products
description: How to add, edit and manage product inventory as a vendor on SokoPlus.
text: Your products are the heart of your shop. Manage them from the Products tab in your dashboard. Adding a product 1. Open Products → Add product . 2. Fill in: - Name and description - Price (and an optional discount price with an end date for offers) - Stock quantity and unit - Category - Images (one or more, uploaded to the platform) 3. Save the product. Product statuses Status Meaning -------- --------- Published Live and visible to buyers. Pending Waiting for admin approval (where required). Draft Not yet published. Archived Hidden from buyers. Managing stock - Update stock quantities as items sell. - The Inventory tab shows stock levels and flags low-stock items so you can reorder in time. - Inventory value is shown on your dashboard overview. Editing & deleting - Edit any product's details or images anytime. - Deleting a product removes it from the marketplace (soft delete — admins can restore it). <Callout type="tip" Use clear photos and accurate descriptions. Products with good images and honest pricing sell better and get better reviews. </Callout Analytics The Analytics tab shows sales over time and per-category performance, so you can see what's working. Want more visibility? See Promoting your shop.

title: Managing services
description: How service providers add, edit and manage their service listings on SokoPlus.
text: Services are how clients find and book you. Manage them from the Services tab. Adding a service 1. Open Services → Add service . 2. Fill in: - Title and description - Base price - Banner image - Category 3. Save the service. Service categories Services are organised into categories such as: - Repair & Maintenance - Graphic Design - Technical Support - Web Development - Photography - Logistics & Delivery - Consulting - Cleaning & Sanitization Managing listings - Edit service details or images anytime. - Archive / delete services you no longer offer. - Admins may need to approve a new service before it goes live — check the status on each listing. <Callout type="tip" Write a clear description that explains what you deliver, how long it takes and what's included in your price. Clear services book better. </Callout Can providers also sell products? Yes. Service providers can also list physical products through the same product tools vendors use. This is useful if your service includes physical deliverables. Bookings When a client books your service, it appears in Bookings — see Managing bookings.

title: Payment methods
description: How to add and manage payment methods on SokoPlus, and how payments work.
text: SokoPlus lets you save and reuse payment methods so checkout is quick. Cash on Delivery (COD) When online payments are switched off, Cash on Delivery (COD) is the payment method: - Checkout lets you place your order without paying online. - You pay the delivery agent in cash when your items arrive. - Ordering and checkout remain fully available while payments are off. When online payments are enabled, you'll have more options — including saved methods and mobile money — to choose from at checkout. Adding a payment method From your dashboard, open the Payments tab (clients) and: 1. Tap Add payment method . 2. Choose the type and provider. 3. Enter the account number. 4. Save. You can set a default method so it's selected automatically at checkout. Managing methods - Add multiple methods. - Edit account details. - Remove methods you no longer use. - Change which method is the default. Payment providers SokoPlus supports payments through trusted providers in the East African market, including mobile money channels such as ClickPesa and M-Pesa when they are enabled. <Callout type="note" If you pay by a method backed by escrow, your funds are held safely until you confirm your order — see Escrow protection. </Callout A note on availability Some payment options depend on platform settings and your region. While online payments are off, Cash on Delivery is the payment method for your orders; once they're enabled, more options appear at checkout.

title: Placing an order
description: How to add items to your cart, choose a delivery zone and complete checkout on SokoPlus.
text: Placing an order on SokoPlus is straightforward. Here's the full flow. 1. Add to cart - Open a product and tap Add to cart . - Open your cart to review quantities. Use the quantity controls to adjust amounts. - Remove items you no longer want. 2. Checkout From the cart, tap Checkout . You'll confirm: - Delivery address — where the order should be sent. - Delivery zone — the vendor's delivery zones and fees for your location. - Payment method — when online payments are off, Cash on Delivery (COD) is the available option: you place the order and pay the delivery agent in cash when your items arrive. If online payments are on, choose a saved method or add a new one. <Callout type="warning" Checkout may be temporarily unavailable if the platform has disabled ordering. You'll see a clear message if so. </Callout 3. Confirm & pay - Review the order summary (items, delivery cost, total). - Confirm the order. With online payments off, no payment is taken at checkout — you pay cash on delivery when the items arrive. If online payments are on, your payment is handled securely — see Payment methods and Escrow protection. - You'll receive an order confirmation with an order code for tracking. 4. Track & receive - Follow the order status in your Orders tab: pending → confirmed → shipped → delivered. - Orders from different vendors are split into suborders , one per vendor. Each suborder has its own status and recipient code — provide the code or scan the QR code at handover. - Confirm receipt once you have your items. What if the vendor doesn't deliver? - You can cancel an order while it's still pending. - If something goes wrong after delivery, request a refund or file a report — see Returns & refunds.

title: Promoting your shop
description: Coupons, flash sales, boosts, subscriptions and referrals — how vendors can grow sales on SokoPlus.
text: SokoPlus gives vendors several tools to attract buyers and grow sales. Coupons Create discount codes that buyers can apply at checkout: - Percentage or fixed amount off - Optional minimum order amount and max discount - Usage limits - Start and expiry dates Buyers apply the code in their cart. You can see how many times each coupon was used. Flash sales Run time-limited promotions with a discount percentage on selected products: - Set a name, description, discount and start/end times. - Buyers see a flash sale banner and can claim the deal before it expires. <Callout type="note" Flash sales and coupons are only available when the relevant platform feature is enabled. </Callout Boosts Product boosts and service boosts give your listings extra visibility — for example, featuring them in trending sections or higher in results. Purchase a boost from your dashboard for a set period. Subscriptions A subscription can unlock premium features for your shop (higher tiers add more capability). You can: - Purchase a plan - Upgrade or downgrade between tiers - View your current plan and its status Referral credits Refer new buyers and vendors to SokoPlus. When your referral signs up and becomes active, you earn credits you can redeem — see Coupons, credits & referrals. Where to find these tools All promotion tools live in your dashboard. Depending on the features enabled on the platform, you'll find Coupons , Flash sales , Boosts and Subscription sections there.

title: Reporting issues
description: How to report bugs, complaints and feature requests, and how to raise a support ticket.
text: If something goes wrong — or you have an idea — SokoPlus makes it easy to tell us. Customer reports A report button floats on every page (visible to non-admin users). Use it to submit: Type Use for ------ --------- Bug Something is broken or not working. Feature request An idea for a new feature. Complaint A problem with a seller or service. Other Anything else. 1. Tap the report button. 2. Choose the type. 3. Write a short message (add a page or order reference if useful). 4. Submit. Admins review reports and can update their status — the team acts on them. Support tickets For questions and issues, raise a support ticket from the Support page: 1. Open Support . 2. Create a ticket with a subject and message (link an order if it relates to one). 3. An admin replies to your ticket. 4. Track the ticket status: open → started → in progress → resolved. What happens next - Reports are reviewed and resolved or dismissed, with notes. - Support tickets are answered directly. - For order problems, keep your order code handy — it helps the team find your order quickly.

title: Returns & refunds
description: How refunds work on SokoPlus, when you can cancel an order, and how to track a refund request.
text: SokoPlus has a refund process for orders that go wrong, plus escrow protection that holds your money until you confirm delivery. Cancelling an order - You can cancel an order while its status is pending . - If it has already been confirmed or shipped, contact the vendor or support instead. - When an order is cancelled, product stock is restored. Requesting a refund If your order is incorrect, damaged, or never arrived: 1. Open the order in your Orders tab. 2. Request a refund and add a reason. 3. An admin reviews the request and either approves or rejects it. Refund statuses: Status Meaning -------- --------- Pending Waiting for admin review. Approved Refund approved and being processed. Rejected Refund declined (usually with a reason). How escrow protects you For supported payment flows, money moves through an escrow account: 1. You pay at checkout — funds are held. 2. The vendor delivers and you confirm receipt. 3. Funds are released to the vendor. If the order is not delivered correctly, the money can be returned to you instead. <Callout type="warning" Always confirm an order as delivered only when you actually have the items. Confirming early releases payment to the vendor. </Callout Not resolved? Submit a customer report using the report button on the site, or raise a support ticket from the Support page. Include your order code so the team can find it quickly.

title: Reviews & feedback
description: How to leave reviews and feedback on SokoPlus, and how moderation keeps the community trustworthy.
text: Reviews and feedback help other buyers make good decisions — and they keep sellers accountable. Reviews You can review: - Products — after interacting with a product page. - Services — after booking a service. - Businesses / shops — after dealing with a shop. A review includes a rating (stars) and a comment. Your reviews appear in your dashboard under Reviews . Order feedback After an order is delivered, you can submit feedback about that order for the business. This is separate from a general review — it's tied to a specific order. Moderation All reviews and feedback are moderated by admins before going public. This means: - Spam and fake reviews are filtered out. - Your review appears after an admin approves it. - Sellers can't post their own promotional reviews. Moderation status Meaning ------------------- --------- Pending Waiting for admin approval. Approved Visible on the platform. Rejected Removed by an admin. <Callout type="note" Please be honest and constructive. Reviews that are abusive, off-topic or promotional may be rejected. </Callout Feedback as a seller Vendors and providers can view their reviews and ratings in their dashboard, including average rating and per-product breakdowns.

title: Platform roles explained
description: A plain-language guide to every role on SokoPlus — clients, vendors, service providers, delivery partners and admins.
text: Every account on SokoPlus has a role that controls what you can see and do. Here's each role in plain language. Client (Buyer) The end consumer. Clients browse the marketplace, place orders, book services, track deliveries and leave reviews. - Access to cart, wishlist, orders and addresses - Can confirm receipt of an order - Can submit feedback after an order is delivered Vendor Sells physical products. Vendors manage their inventory, fulfil orders, assign a delivery team and run promotions. - Product listing and inventory management - Order fulfilment with recipient verification - Delivery team and delivery zones management - Coupons, flash sales and shop boosts (where enabled) Service provider Offers professional services instead of (or in addition to) products. - Service listing with pricing - Booking management (accept / reject / complete) - Working hours management - Can also sell physical products Delivery partner Carries out deliveries on behalf of vendors. - View assigned deliveries - Verify recipient identity or QR code at handover - Toggle active / offline availability - View personal delivery stats Admin roles Role Scope ------ ------- partnerAdmin Day-to-day operations: users, vendors, orders, categories, content, reports. majorAdmin Everything a partnerAdmin can do, plus showcase projects, FAQ and support tickets. superAdmin Full system access, including records, system health and database management. The dashboard Each role gets a personalised dashboard with tabs relevant to that role. For example, a client sees Orders and Wishlist tabs, while a vendor sees Products , Inventory and Delivery Team . See the role-specific guides under Help Centre for how to use each dashboard.

title: Subscriptions & boosts
description: Subscription plans and promotion boosts available to vendors and service providers.
text: Subscriptions and boosts are the ways sellers pay for extra visibility and premium features. Subscriptions A subscription plan gives your shop more listing capacity and a tier of features. Plans range from a free tier up to higher tiers for growing businesses. Tier Typical features ------ ------------------ Free / basic Core selling tools with limited listings Premium / Pro More listing capacity, enhanced promotion and visibility Enterprise Advanced features and capacity for large operations Managing your subscription - Purchase a plan in-app from your dashboard. - Upgrade or downgrade whenever you like. - View your current plan and status at any time. <Callout type="tip" Pick the tier that matches your sales volume. You can upgrade during busy seasons and downgrade later. </Callout Boosts Boosts give specific listings extra visibility for a set period: - Product boost — feature a product in more prominent places. - Service boost — feature a service the same way. Buy a boost in-app from your dashboard, and the boosted listing appears more often across the marketplace. Purchasing Subscriptions and boosts are purchased in-app using your payment methods. The platform confirms the purchase and activates the feature. Referrals & credits You can also earn credits by referring new users — see Coupons, credits & referrals.

title: Tracking your delivery
description: Order statuses, the QR-based 3-way delivery verification, and how to confirm receipt on SokoPlus.
text: Every SokoPlus order follows a clear lifecycle, and deliveries are protected by a 3-way verification system. When you order from more than one vendor, your order is split into suborders — one per vendor/shop. Each suborder has its own status and its own recipient code (plus a QR code at handover), so you track each part of your order separately. Order statuses The statuses below apply to each suborder. An order with items from several vendors can be at different stages at the same time. Status Meaning -------- --------- Pending Order placed, awaiting vendor confirmation. Confirmed Vendor accepted the order. Shipped The order is out for delivery (a delivery partner is assigned). Delivered You confirmed receipt (or the delivery partner verified handover). Cancelled The order was cancelled. You can see your order status in the Orders tab of your dashboard at any time. The 3-way delivery check To make sure orders reach the right person, delivery works like this: 1. When a vendor confirms a suborder, the system generates its recipient code . 2. The delivery partner asks for this recipient code (or a QR code) when handing over the package. 3. The delivery partner enters/verifies the code, and you can also confirm receipt yourself from your Orders tab. <Callout type="note" If a suborder has delivery, you'll be asked for its recipient code or to scan the QR code to complete the handover. </Callout Notifications You'll get updates as your order moves through each stage, if you have order updates notifications enabled. Something went wrong? - If your order never arrives, contact support with your order code. - If you received the wrong or damaged item, see Returns & refunds.

title: Trust & safety
description: How SokoPlus keeps the marketplace safe — verification, moderation, ratings and reporting.
text: Trust is the foundation of SokoPlus. Several layers of safety work together to keep buyers and sellers protected. Verified businesses - Vendors and service providers are reviewed by admins before listing. - Business status is enforced: unapproved businesses cannot sell. - ID verification and selfie verification (where enabled) tie accounts to real people. Moderated content - Reviews and feedback are approved by admins before going public. - Products and services can be subject to approval. - Categories, FAQs and platform content are admin-managed. Account protection - Email and phone OTP verification at signup. - Password change and account deletion are self-service. - Suspended or disqualified accounts are blocked from the platform. - Activity logs track key actions for accountability. Financial protection - Escrow holds buyer funds until delivery is confirmed. - Refunds are reviewed by admins. - Commissions are tracked transparently. Reporting problems Anyone can report problems — see Reporting issues for bugs, complaints and feature requests. <Callout type="tip" If you see something suspicious — a fake shop, a scam message, or abuse — report it. The team reviews every report. </Callout What SokoPlus does NOT allow - Selling without an approved business - Fake or misleading product listings - Abusive messages or harassment - Attempts to complete transactions outside the platform

title: What is SokoPlus?
description: An introduction to the SokoPlus platform and how it connects buyers, vendors and service providers across Tanzania.
text: SokoPlus is a B2B/B2C industrial commerce marketplace purpose-built for Tanzania and the wider East African market. It connects industrial buyers with verified vendors , service providers and delivery partners across all 31 regions of the country. What the platform offers Area What you can do ------ ---------------- Marketplace Buy and sell physical products from verified vendors Services Discover and book professional services (repairs, design, web development, logistics and more) Delivery Order with delivery support and verify handover with a QR-based 3-way check Campus commerce University vendors and student buyers on dedicated regional setups Bilingual The full platform is available in English and Swahili Core ideas 1. Verified sellers — Vendors and service providers go through an approval process before they can list products or services. 2. title: Setting working hours
description: How to set your weekly availability so clients know when you're open.
text: Working hours tell clients (and the platform) when your business is open. Setting your schedule 1. Open Working Hours in your dashboard. 2. For each day of the week (Monday–Sunday): - Toggle the day open or closed . - Set the open time and close time . 3. Save. How working hours are used - Shown on your business/shop page so clients know when you're available. - Used by the platform to check whether your business is currently open. <Callout type="tip" Keep your hours accurate — especially around public holidays — so clients don't book when you're closed. </Callout Delivery consideration If you sell physical products with delivery, your working hours also help vendors and delivery partners plan pickup times.
